measures.name: _Keep_MRPSKU
measures.expression:
VAR col1 = MAXX(VALUES('FACT Combined'[MRPSKU Key]), ABS([_MB52 Future]))
VAR col2 = MAXX(VALUES('FACT Combined'[MRPSKU Key]), ABS([_YM6P]))
VAR col3 = MAXX(VALUES('FACT Combined'[MRPSKU Key]), ABS([_YS10N]))
VAR col4 = MAXX(VALUES('FACT Component Forecast Initial'[MRPSKU Key]), ABS([_Original Forecast]))
RETURN
IF(
    (NOT ISBLANK(col1) && col1 > 0) ||
    (NOT ISBLANK(col2) && col2 > 0) ||
    (NOT ISBLANK(col3) && col3 > 0) ||
    (NOT ISBLANK(col4) && col4 > 0),
    1,
    0
)

measures.name: _Avg Sales Price
measures.expression: SUM('FACT YS10N Average Sales Price'[Net Value USD])/SUM('FACT YS10N Average Sales Price'[Combined Qty])
